summary: Blends two transforms derived from the source buffer a2 with integer parameters a3 and a4, weighted by floats a5 and a6. Computes the total weight v10 = a5 + a6; when FloatRangeCheck reports it is within tolerance of 0.0, copies the four DWORDs of a2 into the output a1 verbatim (or no-ops when a1 == a2). Otherwise builds two intermediate transforms with ThunkToFUN0050e174 using a3 and a4 against the total weight, then blends them into a1 with the normalized weight a6 / v10. Returns a1.

operations.description: Compute v10 = a5 + a6, the total weight of the blend.
Call FloatRangeCheck(v10, 0.0) to test whether the total weight is within tolerance of zero.
When the total weight is near zero, skip blending and copy a2 verbatim into a1 (four DWORDs), skipping the copy only when a1 == a2.
Call ThunkToFUN0050e174(v8, a2, a3, v10) to build the first intermediate transform from a2 and parameter a3 at the total weight.
Call ThunkToFUN0050e174(v9, a2, a4, v10) to build the second intermediate transform from a2 and parameter a4 at the total weight.
Compute v7 = a6 / v10, the fraction of the total weight contributed by a6.
Call ThunkToFUN0050e174(a1, v8, v9, v7) to blend the two intermediate transforms into the output buffer using the normalized weight.
